question: Which one of the following is the largest compartment of stomach in hoofed animals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rumen**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The rumen is the largest compartment of the stomac**h in hoofed animals, also known as ruminants: 
 
• The** rumen is the first part of the stomach and is located on the left side of the animal.**
 
• It can store up to **50 gallo**ns of material in a mature cow.
 
• The rumen is the primary site for microbial fermentation of ingested feed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6a9335500d3179ddfbfde8a55dc2b6794e8d2a71efe6491abd1c982f8202797.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other compartments of a ruminant's stomach are:
 
• **Reticulum**: The second chamber, also known as the honeycomb.
 
 
• It holds about 5 gallons in a mature cow.
 
 
 
• **Omasum: **The third chamber, also known as the book.
 
• **Abomasum: **The fourth chamber, also known as the true stomach.
